answer: Mechanism: VRF-sharded liveness lottery. A public drand beacon (the comet) seeds a per-agent VRF; each agent’s key maps to a random haven shard each epoch. To earn, an identity must answer a shard-specific liveness challenge within a short window. Because shard assignment is unpredictable before the beacon, an attacker cannot prebuild only winning identities; controlling K sybils requires provisioning K live agents, and random raven audits sample shards, slashing unresponsive keys. Cost scales with K × live compute/bandwidth plus audit failure risk.
